process.title: 实现 dijkstra.py 有向图最短路径及测试
process.scope: Owns only dijkstra.py and tests/test_dijkstra.py (new files only). Does not touch nthprime, windscale, or any existing file; does not import other project modules.
process.task: Implement dijkstra.py (standard library only, no imports of other project modules) and tests/test_dijkstra.py as new files; do not modify any existing file. Spec (verbatim from work order): 图以 dict 表示：键为节点名（str），值为邻接 dict（邻居名 → 权重）。边按给定方向为有向边；只作为邻居出现、未作键的节点视为无出边。权重须为 int/float（bool 拒），非数值抛 TypeError；负权重抛 ValueError；graph 非 dict、邻接非 dict、节点名非 str 均抛 TypeError。API: `dijkstra(graph, source) -> tuple[dict, dict]`：返回 (dist, prev)。dist 含图中全部节点（作键或作邻居出现者）：可达者为最短距离（源为 0），不可达者为 `math.inf`。prev 只含可达的非源节点到其前驱节点的映射（源与不可达节点不在 prev 中）。source 不在图中抛 ValueError。`shortest_path(graph, source, target) -> list`：返回源到目标的最短路径节点列表（含两端）；不可达返回 `[]`；source == target 返回 `[source]`；source 或 target 不在图中抛 ValueError。 Acceptance examples (each must have a corresponding test case): 图 G1 = {"A": {"B": 1, "C": 4}, "B": {"C": 2, "D": 5}, "C": {"D": 1}, "D": {}, "E": {}}：`dijkstra(G1, "A")` 的 dist 为 A=0、B=1、C=3、D=4、E=math.inf，prev == {"B": "A", "C": "B", "D": "C"}；`shortest_path(G1, "A", "D") == ["A", "B", "C", "D"]`；`shortest_path(G1, "A", "C") == ["A", "B", "C"]`；`shortest_path(G1, "A", "E") == []`；`shortest_path(G1, "A", "A") == ["A"]`；`shortest_path(G1, "D", "A") == []`（有向，不可逆）；图 G2 = {"S": {"T": 2.5, "U": 1.5}, "U": {"T": 0.5}, "T": {}}：dist["T"] == 2.0、dist["U"] == 1.5、prev == {"U": "S", "T": "U"}、`shortest_path(G2, "S", "T") == ["S", "U", "T"]`；图 G3 = {"A": {"B": 7}}：dist["B"] == 7、prev == {"B": "A"}；`dijkstra({"A": {"B": -1}}, "A")`、`dijkstra(G1, "Z")`、`shortest_path(G1, "A", "Z")` 抛 ValueError；`dijkstra([("A", {})], "A")`、`dijkstra({"A": {"B": "x"}}, "A")`、`dijkstra({"A": {"B": True}}, "A")` 抛 TypeError。Cover every acceptance item with a test case.
